title: Accept a Proposed Story creates the story (proposals accept --create-story)
description: Approving a story_draft Proposal today creates nothing. Accept should create the content item (story_from_story_draft path), link it to the Proposal and its References, and move it to copywriting.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Replaced by the idea-Items model (Ryan 10-31: proposed and idea are one stage). Merged #930: generated ideas filed as Items at idea, migrate-proposals command (dry run by default). Released in 5.66.0.
